player_behavior: Android distinguishes formal turns from rollback audit records; ending counts and recent actions exclude rollback records, while history explains the restoration.
Legacy embedded SQLite databases gain semantic turn kinds on startup and identify prior rollback records from stored outcomes without deleting history.
Desktop and Android model setup accepts optional API Keys; desktop stores them in the OS keychain and Android in flutter_secure_storage.
SQLite, model responses, Run exports and portable bundles contain only a credential reference or has_api_key flag; requests add Authorization only in memory for probe, draft and turn calls.
Blank API Key on edit preserves an existing credential and never reveals it back to the player.
